'''Trapjaw''' was the name given to a massive [[wraid]] that roamed the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Trapjaw fed on a number of creatures, including the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] if it came across them, and was eventually [[Death/Legends|slain]]. During the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]], [[Wraid ampulla jelly]] was harvested from Trapjaw as an ingredient.<ref name="Wraid">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|[World Boss] Special Request: Tatooine|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trapjaw appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released in [[2011]], as the World Boss for the planet Tatooine. This article assumes 100% game completion, and thus assumes that Trapjaw was killed. During the Rakghoul Pandemic World Event in early 2011, Trapjaw was replaced by "Infected Trapjaw," a version of the creature that had been infected by the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]. The event only lasted a short time, and Trapjaw was reverted to its standard appearance afterward.<ref name="TOR" />
